display.name: Cart Service Exemplars
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.text:
This dashboard shows the use of metric exemplars. Exemplars can be used to look up a trace in Jaeger. Only the most recent exemplars may still be available in Jaeger.
Chart panels may require 5 minutes after the Demo is started before rendering data.

spec.query: SELECT * FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'demo.cart.get_cart.latency' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

display.name: 95th Pct Cart GetCart Latency with Exemplars

spec.query:
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) (rate(demo_cart_get_cart_latency_seconds_bucket[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time
